---
title: "Alabama"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

td <- file.path(tempdir(), "alabama_data")
unzip("data/alabama/2026GeneralElectionPrecinctResults.zip", exdir = td)
files <- list.files(td, pattern = "\\.xls$", full.names = TRUE)

senate_results <- map_dfr(files, \(path) {
  county <- basename(path) |>
    sub(pattern = "^2026_GENERAL_ELECTION-", replacement = "") |>
    sub(pattern = "\\.xls$", replacement = "") |>
    tolower() |>
    gsub(pattern = "[._]", replacement = " ") |>
    gsub(pattern = "\\s+", replacement = " ") |>
    trimws()
  if (county == "dekalb") county <- "de kalb"

  df <- read_excel(path)
  sen <- df |>
    filter(
      `Contest Title` == "UNITED STATES SENATOR",
      !Candidate %in% c("Over Votes", "Under Votes", NA)
    )

  precinct_votes <- sen |> select(-c(`Contest Title`, Party, Candidate))
  sen |>
    mutate(votes = rowSums(precinct_votes, na.rm = TRUE), subregion = county) |>
    slice_max(votes, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
})

al_counties <- map_data("county") |>
  filter(region == "alabama") |>
  left_join(senate_results, by = "subregion")

ggplot(al_counties, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group, fill = Candidate)) +
  geom_polygon(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Everett Wess" = "#2b83ba", "Barry Moore" = "#d7191c")
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(
    title = "Alabama US Senate Race (2026)",
    subtitle = "Winning candidate by county",
    fill = "Candidate"
  )
```
